This proves all degrees, parameters and torsion absence; a replayed independent finite checker passed 128 mod-two homology cases and 1050 signed-character checks.

value.rationale: An exact integral representation under every graph automorphism for all thresholds of an infinite natural tree family supplies the hub-exchange twist and complete character lattice, which ordinary homotopy ranks cannot determine. The six-leaf balanced threshold-four case splits into 6 and 4 eigendimensions despite Betti rank 10. The proof provides a reusable natural relative-chain technique, without asserting a broader tree classification.
